remarks: Come see your new home!!!! This Spacious & Bright Colonial home beautifully set along the fairway of E. Gaynor Brennan golf course in popular Hubbard Heights neighborhood! Features include: Open Airy Flow, Sun-filled Kitchen-Great Room Combo with Sliders to Deck overlooking the golf course, Gleaming Hardwood Flooring, Large formal living and dining rooms, Generous bedrooms, including a sizable master bedroom with walk in closet & luxurious full bath. This accommodating home offers a full size laundry/mudroom area, 1-car attached garage, economical gas heat & central air conditioning. Privately & quietly situated at the very end of the road, close to the hospital & very close to exciting downtown Stamford too. ***LANDLORD TO LIVE IN COMPLETELY SEPARATE UNIT ON PROPERTY WITH OWN ENTRANCE***
